summary.text: Natalie Poulson is the Republican candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 3-Position 2, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Luc Jasmin III for an open seat.
A Spokane educator, Poulson placed first in the August 4, 2026 primary with 33.0% of the vote.

paragraphs.text: Poulson was born in Spokane, Washington, and graduated from University High School.
She earned an associate degree from Spokane Community College in 2001, a bachelor's degree from Gonzaga University in 2004, and a graduate degree from Whitworth University in 2007.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, she described an 18-year career as a teacher in Spokane Public Schools and said she had lived in Legislative District 3 for 25 years.
Poulson ran for the same House seat in 2022 as a Republican, advancing from the August 2, 2022 primary and losing the general election to incumbent Democrat Timm Ormsby, 40.1% to 59.8%.

In that 2022 survey, she listed public safety, education and a balanced state budget as her key messages, saying she supported restoring police pursuit authority, parent and school choice, and reduced spending without higher taxes.
